matching_analysis.decision_from_frozen_audit: The question remains direct-outcome unadjudicated. Future work should manipulate patch-only versus explainable presentation with blinded reviewers and record acceptance, understanding and time; explanation-quality scores alone do not validate the claimed integration benefit.
